paper_id: CADRef_ Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection via Class-Aware Decoupled Relative Feature Leveraging
title: CADRef: Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection via Class-Aware Decoupled Relative Feature Leveraging
motivation: DNNs produce confidently incorrect predictions on OOD samples, risking safety-critical deployments like autonomous driving and medical diagnostics
problem_framing: OOD detection framed as binary classification via post-hoc score function; existing feature-based methods reshape features but neglect inherent feature information
key_insight: Using error between sample features and class-aware average features as discriminative criterion, decoupled by sign alignment with model weights
method_signature: Class-aware relative feature error + feature decoupling + error scaling with logit-based scores
evaluation_criteria: AUROC (higher better) and FPR95 (lower better) across ImageNet-1k and CIFAR benchmarks with multiple model architectures
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Feature shaping-based methods collapse on ViT/Swin/ConvNeXt (AUROC below 50%); ViM does not fully utilize feature information, closely approximated by Energy alone
evidence_for_taste: ViM does not fully utilize feature information
positive error as the score substantially reduces OOD detection performance
feature shaping-based methods exhibit architecture-specific behavior
MSP leads to a substantial decline in its performance
thinking_moves: 识别现有方法的共同盲点: 特征重构方法忽视了特征内部蕴含的丰富信息
从特征与logit的数学关系出发, 探索细粒度的特征分解
通过消融实验区分正负误差的不同贡献, 揭示正误差是耦合形式的障碍
利用经验观察(高S_logit时ID/OOD正误差重叠)反向推导修正策略
在多种架构上验证鲁棒性, 不满足于单一数据集上的最优结果
